title: Genealogy_Shared_Definitions
description: Centralized reusable definitions, cross-references, and primitive constraints for the digital genealogy archive. Single source of truth for child schemas (person registry, facts, locations, and source records).

person_id.description: Canonical internal person identifier matching pattern IND- followed by five digits (e.g., IND-00105). Controlled foreign key referencing an existing entity in the Master Person Registry (/data/entities/people.json). Assistants must NEVER mint or assign a new IND-##### unless confirmed in the registry.

temp_person_id.description: Ephemeral staging identifier matching pattern TMP- followed by five digits (e.g., TMP-00001). Strictly reserved for unmerged pep-let staging files during the extraction and pre-ingestion phase. Assistants and intake tools must translate all TMP-##### tokens to canonical IND-##### before committing records to the Master Person Registry (/data/entities/people.json). Never committed to master storage.

any_person_id.description: Accepts either an established canonical IND-##### identifier or an ephemeral TMP-##### staging identifier during batch ingestion.

location_id.description: Canonical internal location identifier matching pattern LOC- followed by five digits (e.g., LOC-00105). Controlled foreign key referencing an existing entity in the Master Location Registry (/data/entities/locations.json).

fact_id.description: Canonical RFC 4122 compliant UUID (GUID) uniquely identifying a discrete fact assertion.

record_urn.description: Archival Uniform Resource Name representing source documents. Follows the hierarchy: URN:COLLECTION:YEAR:SUBTYPE:LOCATOR.

quality_assessment.description: Standardized qualitative assessment rating text legibility, OCR clarity, image quality, or transcription completeness.

quay_score.description: Standard genealogical quality assessment of evidence (maps to GEDCOM QUAY). Values: 0 = Unreliable / estimated; 1 = Questionable reliability; 2 = Secondary evidence; 3 = Direct primary evidence.

date_iso.description: ISO-8601 calendar date or partial date formatted as YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD. Preferred for sorting and database indexing.

date_genealogical.description: Free-form genealogical date string supporting qualifiers (abt, bef, aft, bet) and traditional three-letter month abbreviations (e.g., abt 12 Jan 1880).

date_interpreted.description: Structured date container breaking complex or uncertain genealogical dates into normalized ISO ranges alongside the original verbatim text.

modifier.description: Genealogical certainty or interval flag. Use EXACT for single dates; ABT/BEF/AFT for approximations; BET/FROM_TO for interval spans.

date_start.description: Primary or range start date in ISO format or null.

date_end.description: Range end date in ISO format or null. Populated only when modifier is BET or FROM_TO.

raw_text.description: Literal historical text as written on the document before interpretation (e.g., 'the spring of '82').

age_record.description: Standardized container capturing chronological age expressed in completed years, months, days, or unparsed verbatim historical text.

months.description: Additional months (common in infant vital records or census returns).

vital_year.description: Four-digit calendar year container paired with a long-form certainty modifier flag.

year.description: Four-digit numerical calendar year or null for living/unknown dates.

canonical_name.description: Structured canonical personal name, documentary raw representation, and core vital boundary markers.

raw_name.description: Verbatim name text transcribed directly from the document (e.g., 'Mrs. William Lehman', 'Baby Boy Smith').

associated_role.description: Standardized genealogical association role defining a secondary participant's relationship to an event (maps to GEDCOM ASSO/ROLE).

associated_person_entry.description: Participant linked to an archival record or fact assertion. Supports a canonical person_id (IND-#####) or staging temp_person_id (TMP-#####), a literal name string (for external participants), or both.

person_id.description: Foreign key pointing to an IND-##### entity in the master registry or TMP-##### in a staging container.

name.description: Verbatim name of an external or unregistered participant, or human-readable label for a tracked individual.

is_primary_subject.description: Optional flag indicating if this individual is the primary subject of the article or event (e.g., groom, bride, plaintiff, defendant).

location_details.description: Detailed physical address, micro-jurisdictions, and coordinate points mapping directly to GEDCOM ADDR and MAP structures.

location_name.description: Specific name of the facility, church, parsonage, courthouse, institution, building, or landmark.

address_line_1.description: Primary street address, house number, or building name (maps to GEDCOM ADR1).

address_line_2.description: Secondary address details such as apartment, suite, lot, rural route, or ward subdivision (maps to GEDCOM ADR2).

local_jurisdiction.description: Township, town, city, borough, or civil parish (maps to GEDCOM CITY).

county.description: County, judicial district, or historical county equivalent.

state_or_province.description: State, province, or federal territory (maps to GEDCOM STAE).

country.description: National sovereignty or country name (maps to GEDCOM CTRY).

postal_code.description: Postal code or ZIP code (maps to GEDCOM POST).

coordinates.description: Geographic point coordinates for spatial mapping (maps to GEDCOM MAP.LATI / MAP.LONG).

location.description: Standardized genealogical place entity providing a normalized lookup string, historical transcription, and optional physical address breakdown.

standardized.description: Normalized comma-separated jurisdiction populated to the known depth (e.g., 'Carlisle, Cumberland, Pennsylvania, USA'). Used as the primary lookup index.

verbatim.description: Literal historical place text as transcribed directly from the source document (e.g., 'Borough of Carlisle', 'at parsonage').

details.description: Optional breakdown of physical address components or null.

cause_of_death.description: Structured medical certification and etiology detailing manner, causes, and circumstances of death.

immediate_cause.description: Primary disease or condition directly resulting in death.

antecedent_causes.description: Sequentially underlying morbid conditions leading up to the immediate cause.

contributory_causes.description: Other significant conditions contributing to death but not resulting in the underlying cause.

interval_onset.description: Verbatim duration between onset and death (e.g., '2 days', 'several years').

autopsy_performed.description: Indicates whether a post-mortem surgical examination was conducted.

findings_considered.description: Indicates whether autopsy findings were utilized in determining the cause of death.

source_media.description: Derivative scan image metadata and legibility assessment for an archival source record.

image_filename.description: Derivative scan image filename located in /data/media/.

image_quality.description: Assessment of visual legibility and scan clarity.

page_or_side.description: Descriptor for multi-image records (e.g., 'Front', 'Reverse', 'Application Page 1', 'Minister Return').

news_clipping.description: Physical clipping segment metadata linking visual scans to page and layout positions.

page.description: Page number or identifier where the clipping appears.

column.description: Column number or layout position on the page.

section.description: Newspaper section identifier (e.g., A, B, Local, Classifieds).

image_filename.description: Specific visual scan file name corresponding to this clipping segment.

image_quality.description: Assessment of visual text legibility and image scan clarity.

transcript_record.description: Structured transcript container providing verbatim text, abstract, search keywords, word count, and standalone file linkages.

verbatim_text.description: Literal historical transcription of the document or clipping text.

word_count.description: Total count of words in verbatim_text (used to determine standalone file generation threshold).

transcript_filename.description: Exact derivative filename of the standalone text file stored in /data/transcript/ (populated when word_count > 500).

summary.description: Comprehensive abstract or factual summary of the article or document content, scaling to the depth of the text.

keywords.description: Indexed terms, topics, organizations, or search tags extracted from the text.

text_quality.description: Standardized assessment of transcription fidelity and completeness.

external_identifiers.description: Cross-reference container mapping internal IND-##### persons to external software pointers, global UUIDs, and genealogical repositories.

gedcom_xref.description: File-level pointer tag from an active GEDCOM export (e.g., @I0001@). Note: pointers may change across exports.

gedcom_uid.description: Persistent 32-character hexadecimal string or 36-character UUID from GEDCOM UID / _UID tags.

gedcom_refn.description: User-defined reference or catalog number recorded under the GEDCOM REFN tag.

fact_external_identifiers.description: Cross-reference container mapping internal fact assertions to external GEDCOM event records and source citations.

gedcom_tag.description: Standard 3- or 4-letter GEDCOM event or attribute tag (e.g., BIRT, DEAT, CENS, RESI, MARR, OCCU, DIV).

gedcom_uid.description: Persistent event-level UUID assigned by external genealogy software.

source_xref.description: Pointer tag linking directly to an external GEDCOM source entity (e.g., @S0012@).

note_entry.description: Structured annotation or research task linked to an entity or fact.

note_id.description: Unique or sequential identifier for the note.

title.description: Optional short summary or title for the note.
